test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: I will be drive into town later on.
I will be driving into town later on.
I might drive into town later on.
I could be driving into town later on.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The direction of the question is **"Select the sentence that has a grammatical error."** and **option 1 is grammatically incorrect.**
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**be drive**" instead of "**be driving**."
 
• In future continuous tense, the correct form is "**will be driving**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I will be driving into town later on**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I** will be driving** into town later on."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "I will be driving into town later on" – This sentence is grammatically** correct** and uses the correct form of the future continuous tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "I might drive into town later on" – This sentence is grammatically **correct** and uses the correct form of the modal verb "might".
 
• **Option 4:** "I could be driving into town later on" – This sentence is grammatically **correct **and uses the correct form of the modal verb "could" in the future continuous tense.
